text: No matter how dark the night, morning always comes.
The flow of time is always cruel, but its speed seems different for each person.
by: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask

text: Don't be sorry. Be better.
We all make choices, but in the end, our choices make us.
Even in dark times, we cannot relinquish the things that make us human.
To live is to suffer, to survive is to find some meaning in the suffering.
The right man in the wrong place can make all the difference in the world.
A hero need not speak. When he is gone, the world will speak for him.
It's not about how hard you hit. It's about how hard you can get hit and keep moving forward.
Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, today is a gift - that is why it is called the present.
It is not our abilities that show what we truly are, it is our choices.
The flower that blooms in adversity is the most rare and beautiful of all.
Great men are not born great, they grow great.
With great power comes great responsibility.
Whatever comes our way, whatever battle is raging inside us, we always have a choice.
Stay hungry, stay foolish.
The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
Believe you can and you're halfway there.
It always seems impossible until it is done.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
Excellence is not an act, but a habit.
Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
